source.contract:
defp build({:error, {:write_admission, reason}}) when is_atom(reason),
    do: %{
      code: "storage_unavailable",
      message: "writes are not admitted while this instance is being switched",
      status: 503,
      reason: "write_admission_#{reason}",
      hint:
        "Transient: this instance is holding writes for a migration step, so " <>
          "nothing was stored or refused on its merits. Retry once the switch " <>
          "completes; if it persists, the instance needs explicit recovery."
    }

  defp build({:error, reason}) when is_binary(reason),
    do: %{code: "internal_error", message: reason, status: 500}

  # A JSON

reason: Driver confused the existing public code with the diagnostic reason. Frozen Errors.build maps write_admission tuple to code storage_unavailable/status503/reason write_admission_admission_closed. New driver asserts BOTH exact fields plus HTTP request-id; no looser allow-list/controller/server repair.
limits: Failed run has no drained trace, unknown400, after-error whole DB verification or natural DOWN proof. It cannot be called a completed HTTP contract. Owned backendPG stopped/identities retained, first failure preserved.
